create_DatabaseMigration: create a DatabaseMigration document with a version string and description string
query_DatabaseMigration: query DatabaseMigration documents using the mongoengine QuerySetManager interface
drop_DatabaseMigration_collection: drop the DatabaseMigration collection from the database for cleanup
clean_maintenance_database: clean the maintenance database by dropping all DatabaseMigration records
use_QuerySetManager: use QuerySetManager as a descriptor to add typed QuerySet access to a mongoengine Document
